desc: The Archon Firearms Gen 2, Type B pistol with interchangeable grip textures and a unique modular design, the pistol can be customized not only to fit individual shooter grips but also allows for easy modification between full size, compact and sub-compact configurations. With AF-Speedlock technology shooters experience reduced muzzle rise, minimized recoil and rapid target re-acquisition. Features optic ready slide and Picatinny rail. Includes two magazines 15rd & 18rd, three back straps and two grip extenders.
